Distribution. China (Xinjiang). Comparative diagnosis. This species is similar to C. lobatus sp. nov., but differs from the latter by having apical margin of clypeus not thick medially, mesopleuron granulose-punctate, propodeal area superomedia granulose, latero-longitudinal carina strongly developed, vein 1 cu-a opposite M & RS, second metasomal tergite as long as its apical width, and metasoma entirely black.

Ecological information and distribution. Scattered or gregarious on the ground or on twigs in forest dominated by Picea in an elevational range of 3750 – 3800 m. Southwestern China.

STRATIGRAPHY. — Mu (1986) reported Heteroporella xizangensis from the northern slope of Langshan Mountain in the Duoba District, Baingoin County. The type-level is indicated as belonging to the lower part of the Langshan Formation containing Morelletpora turgida (Radoičić) and Palorbitolina lenticularis (Blumenbach) indicating an early Aptian age.
